propositions: All mode="structured" consumers must route through the single PydanticAIRunner facade using one bounded Pydantic Agent run per output mode (native/prompted)
The structured_retry_limit knob is retained as the output-retry-allowance cap, with structured_retry_limit=0 yielding zero output-repair retries and preserving the single-shot fail-safe
Bespoke fresh-Agent output-attempt loops must be removed; output repair must be implemented as in-Agent bounded retry (retries={"output":N}), not scheduler reconstruction
A well-formed first response must trigger exactly one outer agent.run_sync call; exactly two calls only on the bug-895c native-to-prompted downgrade path; never a third
Provider fallback eligibility, tool limits, timeout/transport ownership, provenance, artifact policy, and serialized output shapes must remain unchanged across all in-tree structured consumers
